title: Star English!
sub: Belajar sambil bermain · Untuk siswa Kelas 6 SD
cando: Membicarakan rencana dan cita-cita (will / be going to).
Membicarakan transportasi dan aturan lalu lintas.
Membuat undangan, ungkapan sopan, dan poster lingkungan.

text.pron_note: Tulisan di dalam garis miring, misalnya apple /é-pel/, adalah cara mengucapkan kata itu. Bacalah seperti membaca tulisan bahasa Indonesia. Huruf é dibaca seperti “e” pada kata “bebek”, sedangkan e biasa dibaca seperti “e” pada kata “emas”. Tanda ini hanya bantuan — cara terbaik tetap mendengarkan guru, orang tua, lagu, atau video berbahasa Inggris. 🎧

goals: Memakai Simple Past Tense untuk menceritakan kejadian lampau.
Mengenal kata kerja beraturan (-ed) dan tidak beraturan.

sections.title: Simple Past Tense — Kalimat lampau
head: Jenis kalimat
Rumus
Contoh
rows: I **didn't go** to school last Sunday.
**Did** you **enjoy** your holiday? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
sections.after: Kata keterangan waktu lampau: yesterday (kemarin), last week/month/year (… lalu), two days ago (dua hari yang lalu), in 2024.

sections.title: Irregular verbs — Kata kerja tidak beraturan (harus dihafal!)
sections.label: learn

sections.title: My Holiday in Bali 🌴
paras: Last December, my family and I went to Bali. We flew from Jakarta and arrived at Ngurah Rai Airport at noon. ✈️
On the first day, we visited Kuta Beach. The sand was white and soft. My brother and I swam in the sea and built a sandcastle. In the evening, we watched the beautiful sunset. 🌅
On the second day, we went to Ubud. We saw many monkeys in the Monkey Forest. One monkey took my father's hat! We all laughed. 🐒
On the last day, we bought some souvenirs for our friends. I was sad to leave Bali, but I was very happy. It was the best holiday ever!

sections.instr: Jawab berdasarkan bacaan “My Holiday in Bali”!
sections.ans: 1. a · 2. b (flew = terbang) · 3. b · 4. c · 5. c
items: When did the family go to Bali?|last December|last July|yesterday
How did they go to Bali?|by ship|by plane|by bus
What did they see in Ubud?|elephants|many monkeys|dolphins
What did a monkey take?|a camera|a banana|the father's hat
How did the writer feel about the holiday?|bored|angry|very happy

goals: Membicarakan rencana dengan will dan be going to.

sections.title: Future: will & be going to
head: Bentuk
Dipakai untuk
Contoh
rows: I'm thirsty. I **will** buy a drink. / I **will** help you. / It **will** rain.
I **am going to** visit my uncle next week.
I **won't** be late again. I promise!
sections.after: Keterangan waktu masa depan: tomorrow (besok), next week/month/year (… depan), tonight (nanti malam), soon (segera), in the future (di masa depan).

sections.title: Holiday plans — Rencana liburan
lines: What are you going to do during the school holiday?
Apa yang akan kamu lakukan selama liburan sekolah?
I'm going to visit my grandparents in Yogyakarta. We're going to see Borobudur Temple!
Aku akan mengunjungi kakek-nenek di Yogyakarta. Kami akan melihat Candi Borobudur!
Wow, that sounds fun! I'm going to join a swimming course.
Wah, seru! Aku akan ikut kursus renang.
Great! I will send you some photos.
Keren! Aku akan mengirimimu beberapa foto.
Thanks! I will wait for them. 📸

sections.title: When I Grow Up 👩‍🔬
paras: My name is **Putra**. I am twelve years old. When I grow up, I will be a scientist.
I love Science because it is interesting. I want to find new ways to make our Earth clean and green. 🌍
Next year, I am going to join a science club in junior high school. I am also going to read many science books.
I know it will not be easy, but I will study hard. I believe I can make my dream come true!

items: Putra wants to be a doctor.
He is going to join a science club next year.
He thinks it will be easy.

sections.instr: Lengkapi dengan will atau be going to (am/is/are going to)!
sections.ans: 1. is going to (ada bukti: awan gelap) — will juga dapat diterima · 2. will · 3. are going to · 4. will · 5. is going to
items: Look at the dark clouds! It ___ rain.
The phone is ringing. — I ___ answer it!
We ___ visit the museum next Saturday. We already have the tickets.
I promise I ___ clean my room.
My sister ___ study in Bandung next year.

sections.title: Examples — Contoh kalimat
Indonesia's Records 🇮🇩
paras: Indonesia is the largest archipelago country in the world. It has more than 17,000 islands!

Lake Toba in North Sumatra is the largest lake in Indonesia. It is much bigger than Lake Singkarak. Puncak Jaya in Papua is the highest mountain in Indonesia. It is higher than Mount Semeru in East Java.
The Kapuas River in West Kalimantan is the longest river in Indonesia. It is longer than the Mahakam River.
Jakarta is the biggest city in Indonesia. It is bigger and busier than Surabaya. Which place in Indonesia is the most beautiful? You decide! 😉

items: What is the largest lake in Indonesia?|Lake Singkarak|Lake Toba|Lake Poso
Which is higher?|Mount Semeru|Puncak Jaya|They are the same
What is the longest river in Indonesia?|Mahakam|Musi|Kapuas

goals: Menyebut alat transportasi darat, laut, dan udara.

sections.title: How do you go to school?

Arti
rows: My father goes to the office **by** train. 🚆
**How long does it take?** — It takes fifteen minutes.
sections.after: Pakai by + kendaraan (by car, by bus, by plane), tetapi on foot untuk jalan kaki.

sections.title: Traffic signs & rules — Rambu dan aturan
sections.label: learn

sections.html:
must = harus · mustn't (must not) = tidak boleh / dilarang
  • You must stop when the light is red. 🔴
  • You must wear a helmet when you ride a motorcycle. ⛑️
  • You mustn't cross the street when the light is green for cars.
  • Children mustn't ride a motorcycle. They are too young!
sections.title: Ingat, ya!
Going to Grandma's Village 🏡
paras: Last month, Dewi went to her grandma's village in Lampung. First, she went to the bus station by taxi.
Then, she took a bus to Merak Port. From the port, she took a ferry across the Sunda Strait. It took about two hours. She saw the blue sea from the ferry. 🌊
After that, she took a bus again to her grandma's village. It was a long trip, but it was exciting!

sections.ans: 1 by taxi · 2 by bus to Merak Port · 3 by ferry · 4 by bus to the village
sections.after: ☐ by ferry☐ by taxi☐ by bus to the village☐ by bus to Merak Port

goals: Membuat kalimat perintah dan larangan: Let's… / Don't…

sections.title: 3R — Reduce, Reuse, Recycle ♻️
items: **Reduce** /ri-dyuus/ — Use less plastic. Bring your own bag and bottle. 🛍️
Kurangi — Kurangi plastik. Bawa tas dan botol sendiri.
**Reuse** /ri-yuuz/ — Use things again. Use old jars as pencil holders. 🫙
Gunakan kembali — Pakai lagi barang bekas, misalnya toples jadi tempat pensil.
**Recycle** /ri-sai-kel/ — Turn old things into new things. Recycle paper and bottles. 📦
Daur ulang — Ubah barang lama menjadi barang baru.

Arti
rows: **Turn off** the lights when you leave the room. 💡

sections.title: Clean Friday at Our School 🧹
paras: Every Friday morning, our school has a program called “Clean Friday”. All students and teachers clean the school together.
Some students sweep the classroom floor. Some students clean the windows and water the plants. Other students pick up trash in the schoolyard and separate it into organic and inorganic trash.
We make compost from the organic trash, like leaves and food waste. We sell the plastic bottles to the waste bank. The money goes to our class savings. 💰
Thanks to Clean Friday, our school is clean, green, and healthy. Remember, a clean environment starts with us!

items: Only the teachers clean the school.
They make compost from leaves and food waste.
They sell plastic bottles to the waste bank.

sections.instr: Pisahkan sampah ini: banana peel, plastic bottle, dry leaves, can, paper, fish bones, candy wrapper, vegetable waste
sections.ans: Organic: banana peel, dry leaves, fish bones, vegetable waste · Inorganic: plastic bottle, can, paper*, candy wrapper (*kertas bisa didaur ulang; dalam pemilahan sekolah biasanya masuk anorganik/daur ulang)
